scn	ALTRichKidHit

ref rTarget
ref rAttacker
float iCaps


begin Function {rTarget, rAttacker}
	
	iCaps = player.getitemcount caps001
	iCaps *= 0.001
	iCaps = Floor iCaps
	;print $iCaps
	;print $rTarget.getav health
	if rTarget.GetDead
		;print "dead"
		return
	elseif iCaps > rTarget.getav health
		rTarget.kill rAttacker
		;print "kill"
	else
		rTarget.damageav health iCaps
		;print "damage"
	endif
	;print "test"

end

scn ALTBackPilotUDF

ref rRef

begin Function {}
	ALTStartQ.iWealth = 0
	ALTStartQ.rMarker = ALTPilotMarker
	Player.additemalt ArmorRecon 1 55 1 1
	Player.additemalt ArmorReconHelmet 1 40 1 1
	ALTQ.sVeronicLoc = "Searchlight."
	tapcontrol 8
	ALTVertiSuppliesRef.enable
	rRef = StringtoRef "FalloutNV.esm:15461A"
	If isformvalid rRef
		showmap rRef
	EndIf
	Player.cripplelimb 4
	Player.cripplelimb 3
	Player.addperk powerarmortraining
	
	Eval Player.damageav health ((Player.getav health) * 0.7)
	ALTQ.sMajorKnight = "Traveler."
end

scn ALTBackChildofAtomUDF

begin Function {}
	ALTStartQ.iWealth = 1
	ALTStartQ.rMarker = ALTChildofAtomMarker
	ALTQ.sVeronicLoc = "The East Coast."
	Player.additemalt OutfitWasteland03 1 55 1 1
	Player.addperk RadChild 
	Player.modav RadiationRads 75
	Player.addspellNS ALTAtomEffect
	Player.additem IrradiatedWaterUnpurified 3
	ALTQ.sMajorKnight = "Missionary."
end
